message: Voho just launched an AI claims desk in Saudi Arabic: a driver calls after a minor accident and the claim is logged in 69 seconds

lines.text: Unbelievable. Voho just launched an AI claims desk that logs a car accident in Saudi Arabic in sixty-nine seconds.
You create an agent on Voho, set it to Saudi Arabic, and tell it what a claim needs. It was saved in twenty-four seconds.
Then the rules: it asks about injuries first, it never decides who is at fault, and it never invents a claim number.
I called it after a minor accident. It took my policy number, the road and the Najm report, and logged the claim for fourteen cents.
That is every accident call answered and logged. Try it at app dot voho dot A I.
